name: Press Metal Aluminium Holdings Berhad
overview: 2026年，Press Metal Aluminium Holdings Berhad 完成收购 PMB Technology Berhad 约35.6%股权，现金代价 RM464,952,909.40，该交易于2026年9月14日完成。公司业务线未披露其他产能扩张、新业务或退出事项。
overview_en: In 2026, Press Metal Aluminium Holdings Berhad completed the acquisition of approximately 35.6% equity interest in PMB Technology Berhad for a total cash consideration of RM464,952,909.40, with completion on 14 September 2026. No other capacity expansion, new business, or exit was disclosed for the business lines.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年完成收购 PMB Technology Berhad 约35.6%股权。
segments.note_en: Completed the acquisition of approximately 35.6% equity interest in PMB Technology Berhad this year.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 收购的所有先决条件于2026年9月9日达成，交易于2026年9月14日完成。
actions.text_en: All conditions precedent were fulfilled on 9 September 2026 and the acquisition was completed on 14 September 2026.

actions.title: Proposed acquisition of 664,218,442 ordinary shares in PMB Technology Berhad ("PMBT", and the ordinary shares in PMBT shall be referred to a
actions.text: 952,909.40 收购 PMB Technology Berhad 664,218,442 股普通股，约占其35.6%股权。
actions.text_en: Proposed acquisition of 664,218,442 ordinary shares in PMB Technology Berhad, representing approximately 35.6% equity interest, for a total cash consideration of RM464,952,909.40.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 于2026年8月3日与卖方签订有条件股份买卖协议，推进上述收购。
actions.text_en: Entered into a conditional share sale agreement with the vendors on 3 August 2026 to proceed with the proposed acquisition.

model_changes.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
model_changes.text: 完成收购 PMB Technology Berhad 约35.6%股权，集团业务组合新增该联营/投资权益。
model_changes.text_en: Completed the acquisition of approximately 35.6% equity interest in PMB Technology Berhad, adding this associate/investment interest to the group's business portfolio.
